transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Imran. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Imran. My voicemail isn't working at all. People tell me they're leaving messages but I never get them, and I've missed some important calls.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Missing important calls is really stressful, I'm sorry. Let's look into it. Could you confirm the address on the account, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Siobhan. So callers say they're leaving voicemails, but none of them reach you, and you've missed some important calls. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you dial 1 2 1 to listen, what do you hear?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says I have no new messages.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you get a missed call notification when someone rings and you don't answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the missed call shows up, but no voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you recently change your phone or your SIM?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's probably it. Your new phone has call forwarding switched on to a number that isn't our voicemail. I've reset the forwarding from our side to point back to S-Net voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That should fix it. Messages will start coming through from now on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Siobhan. Have a good day.
